purpose: P8 water security and sanitation linkage audit: verify evidence independence, safety boundaries, and justified cross-domain relations without graph inflation.

coverage.relation_contract: Each cross-slice Relation has explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and at least two participants.
coverage.corpus_scope: Current corpus through P8 water-security/sanitation correction cycle.

findings.basis: wastewater-basics originally had one source for all three Claims; independent WHO evidence was added with one additional Evidence Use per Claim.
Added justified water-quality ↔ treatment relation using WHO/EPA source provenance.
Added justified sanitation ↔ wastewater relation using WHO sanitation/wastewater source provenance.
Water-treatment Claims retain explicit non-universal applicability; sanitation and wastewater remain source-bounded and non-site-specific.

conclusion.next_step: Repeat independent substantive validation, then create P8 CLEAN checkpoint and require independent Reference, Release Gate and Offline 3/3 on the checkpoint.

epistemic_boundary: Relations, conformance and provenance do not establish truth and do not replace independent evidence.
